adventures.name: Arashiyama Bamboo Forest & Heritage Tea Ceremony
adventures.description: Embark on an intimate, early morning journey through the whispering bamboo groves of Arashiyama before the crowds arrive. Walk centuries-old moss stone pathways led by a licensed cultural historian, explore the Tenryu-ji Zen garden, and participate in an authentic private matcha tea ceremony hosted in a 300-year-old machiya estate.
highlights: Private early access to Arashiyama bamboo paths
Master-led matcha preparation and wagashi sweet tasting
Guided exploration of UNESCO Tenryu-ji Sogenchi garden
English and Japanese bilingual cultural specialist
inclusions: Formal tea master session with ceremonial grade matcha
Traditional bamboo souvenir crafted by local artisan
Bottled spring water and organic green tea
exclusions: Gratuities for the guide and tea master

itinerary.detail: Experience the famous grove during serene dawn stillness with photography guidance.

itinerary.detail: Contemplate the 14th-century pond and dry rock landscape with our historian.

itinerary.title: Private Machiya Tea Ritual
itinerary.detail: Sit in a restored wooden townhouse for an authentic ceremonial matcha experience.

adventures.meetingPoint: Saga-Arashiyama Station North Exit, Ukyo Ward, Kyoto

adventures.name: Path of the Gods Ridge Trek & Organic Olive Oil Tasting
adventures.description: Traverse the legendary Sentiero degli Dei high above the sapphire waters of the Amalfi coastline. Breathe in wild rosemary and sage along ancient stone trails, descend through century-old olive orchards, and enjoy a private farmhouse lunch featuring extra virgin olive oil pressed on-site and artisanal sheep cheeses.
highlights: Spectacular cliffside panoramic vistas of Positano & Capri
Guided by certified Alpine & coastal trail leader
Exclusive rustic lunch at family-run olive grove estate
Tasting flight of 4 cold-pressed olive oils & local wine
inclusions: Full farm-to-table lunch with freshly baked focaccia & cheeses
Olive oil tasting seminar with fourth-generation producer
Local transport assistance back to Bomerano/Positano
exclusions: Stout hiking footwear (please bring sturdy trainers or hiking boots)

itinerary.title: Bomerano Trailhead Departure

adventures.name: Gornergrat Glacier Panorama & Alpine Lake Trek
adventures.description: Witness the dramatic pyramid of the Matterhorn mirrored in pristine alpine waters. Ascend aboard the historic Gornergrat cogwheel train, hike across wildflower meadows and moraine stone paths, and savor warm Swiss fondue at a secluded mountain hut perched 2,800 meters above sea level.
highlights: Unobstructed views of 29 four-thousand-meter Alpine peaks
Riffelsee mirror photography of the iconic Matterhorn
Swiss raclette & fondue tasting at historic mountain refugio
Glaciology insights from local alpine naturalist
inclusions: Traditional alpine lunch with regional Gruyère & Valais wine
Warm thermal trail blanket and high-altitude tea
exclusions: Gornergrat Bahn railway pass (guidance provided on booking with Swiss Pass)

adventures.name: Tegallalang Terraced Fields, Organic Herbal Farm & Sound Healing
adventures.description: Escape deep into the emerald green heart of Ubud. Walk hidden rice terraces preserved through the ancient subak cooperative irrigation system. Discover indigenous medicinal plants with a local Balinese herbalist, blend your own traditional jamu elixir, and unwind with an immersive Tibetan singing bowl sound bath.
highlights: Private path access away from commercial tourist swings
Hands-on jamu herbal elixir making workshop
Restorative 45-minute sound healing in an open bamboo shala
Vegan organic garden lunch served on banana leaves
inclusions: Sound meditation session with certified practitioner
exclusions: Personal transport beyond Central Ubud pickup points

adventures.name: Kiyomizu-dera Dawn Walk & Artisan Pottery Masterclass
adventures.description: Experience the historic wooden terrace of Kiyomizu-dera bathed in early dawn light over the Higashiyama hills. Then visit a traditional Kyo-yaki ceramic workshop tucked into preserved stone alleys, where you will shape and glaze your own authentic ceramic tea bowl at the wheel.
highlights: Uncrowded early dawn access to Kiyomizu stage
One-on-one pottery guidance on electric and kick wheels
International shipping of your glazed pottery piece included
Historic stroll through Ninenzaka & Sannenzaka
inclusions: Clay materials, firing, and overseas shipping of 1 finished cup/bowl
exclusions: Additional pottery pieces beyond the included piece

adventures.name: Capri & Blue Grotto Vintage Wooden Gozzo Boat Charter
adventures.description: Sail across azure Mediterranean waters on an authentic handcrafted Italian Gozzo boat. Anchor in secluded sea grottos with fluorescent emerald water, swim along the dramatic Faraglioni rock formations, and dock for lunch in Capri's charming Marina Grande.
highlights: Skippered tour aboard classic varnished mahogany Gozzo
Snorkeling gear provided in translucent marine reserves
Complimentary chilled Prosecco, San Pellegrino & fresh figs
3 hours free time to explore Capri town and Anacapri
inclusions: Prosecco aperitivo with cured olives and taralli

adventures.name: Moraine Lake Sunrise Canoe & Valley of the Ten Peaks Trail
adventures.description: Glice across the glassy, glacier-fed turquoise waters of Moraine Lake as the first rays of sunlight illuminate the snow-dusted Ten Peaks. Follow a guided wildlife trek through fragrant subalpine fir forest to the Sentinel Pass viewpoint.
highlights: Guaranteed early dawn access to restricted Moraine Lake road
1-hour cedar strip canoe paddle on pristine waters
Interpretive naturalist guide sharing bear biology and geology
Gourmet hot chocolate and Canadian maple pastries
inclusions: Parks Canada commercial shuttle permit access
Premium canoe rental and life vest equipment
Bear safety equipment (bear spray provided to guide)

adventures.name: Cape Point Fynbos Coastal Hike & Boulders Penguin Colony
adventures.description: Travel the dramatic Chapmans Peak Drive down to the southwestern tip of the African continent. Spot wild ostriches, baboons, and sea birds amidst indigenous floral kingdom fynbos, followed by an up-close boardwalk visit to the African penguin colony at Boulders Beach.
highlights: Scenic drive voted one of the top 10 coastal drives in the world
Lighthouse hike at Cape of Good Hope nature reserve
Boardwalk encounter with endangered African jackass penguins
Fresh linefish lunch in the historic maritime village of Kalk Bay
inclusions: All national park conservation entry fees
exclusions: Lunch and beverages at Harbour House restaurant
